// why: Type checking for CI, which `bun test` does not do — bun strips types and runs.
That matters most for `src/errors.ts`: `fail(c, code, detail)` types the detail per
code so a missing or misspelt field is a build error, and without a checker in the
pipeline that guarantee only holds on whichever machine last ran tsc.
Nothing under `src` is excluded any more. The test files used to be, because they
carried errors that were noise rather than bugs — `.then` on Hono's
`Response | Promise<Response>`, union fields read without narrowing. Those were real
holes in the instrument the rest of the suite is measured with, and #397 closed them:
`request` and `at` in `test-utils.ts` are where the assumptions now live.
